validity.recommendation: Review the entire UBTG-1 family (P1898 UBTG-1-Berri, P1899 UBTG-1-Berri 2, P1900 UBTG-km56-AY-1 KP916, P1910/P1911 UBTG-1-km0-UBTG-1-km56, P1912 Hawiyah-UBTG-1-km0) as kilometer-point SEGMENTS of one physical UBTG-1 transmission corridor, not independent pipelines. Confirm against the source table before treating P1901's 204 km as additive length; likely a segment double-count. Re-verify the 204 km / dia 28,30,38,40 spec against the underlying engineering paper.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: The UBTG (Uthmaniyah-Berri Transmission Gas) system is real Aramco infrastructure - independent sources confirm UBTG-3 (152 km, Uthmaniyah->Juaymah/Berri) and UBTG-4 (Shedgum->Ju'aymah, built by Saipem, confirmed by ETE Readymix contractor page). So the corridor physically exists. HOWEVER, no independent source confirms a discrete pipeline entity named 'UBTG-1km-Juanymah' of 204 km. PROVENANCE: The whole GEM UBTG-* family (P1898-P1900, P1910-P1912 and this row) traces to a ResearchGate table titled 'UBTG-1 Pipeline Characteristics' (figure tbl3, paper 291522747) - an academic pipeline-integrity/corrosion study that segments the single UBTG-1 line by kilometer markers (km0, km56, etc.). 'UBTG-1km-Juanymah' reads as the UBTG-1 segment terminating at Juaymah, i.e. a waypoint slice of ONE corridor, not a standalone pipe. That ResearchGate page is 403-blocked to automated fetch so I could not read the numbers directly. CITATIONS PROBLEM: the two refs on the gem.wiki page (OPEC ASB2012 p.75; ASB2013 p.79) do NOT support this row - url_verifier confirms ASB2012.pdf returns 200 but contains no occurrence of 'pipeline'; ASB pages are generic annual statistics bulletins, not pipeline-specific. So the entity currently rests only on the (inaccessible) integrity-study table plus GEM-derived material. SPEC: 204 km and diameters 28/30/38/40 in could not be independently corroborated; the mixed 4-value diameter set is itself consistent with a multi-segment corridor rather than a single pipe of one bore. CLASSIFICATION CAVEAT: Juaymah is principally an NGL fractionation/LPG export terminal; MEED reporting describes the KGP->Juaymah feed as a 24-in 103-km NGL line and Aramco material describes liquids being piped to Ju'aymah for fractionation. The 'UBTG' name implies transmission (dry) gas, so I keep commodity as a caveat rather than a hard reclassification, but a reviewer should confirm whether this Juaymah-bound segment carries dry gas vs NGL. ATTRIBUTION: Owner Saudi Aramco 100% is safe (entire MGS/UBTG network is Aramco). Endpoints in GEM are blank except country=Saudi Arabia; from the corridor it is plausibly an Uthmaniyah-area node to Juaymah, but no source confirms this specific segment's endpoints, so I did not stage them. VERDICT: concern - primary = duplicate/segmentation (km-point slice of UBTG-1 likely double-counting corridor length), secondary = unverifiable spec and a citation set that does not actually support the row.

summary: P1901 is a kilometer-point SEGMENT of the real UBTG-1 (Uthmaniyah-Berri transmission gas) corridor extracted from an academic integrity-study table; concern: likely segment double-count with P1898/P1899/P1900/P1910/P1911/P1912, unverifiable 204 km/dia spec, and OPEC-bulletin citations that do not actually mention any pipeline.
